description: This file is a JavaScript source code that defines a class 'TinyMCE_Popup' and its prototype methods for handling TinyMCE editor popup windows, including initialization, resizing, and event handling.

classes.name: TinyMCE_Popup
classes.description: A class that manages TinyMCE popup windows, providing methods for initialization, resizing, executing commands, and closing the popup.

methods.name: findWin(w)
methods.description: Finds and returns the window containing the 'tinyMCE' object by checking parent, opener, and top windows.

methods.name: init()
methods.description: Initializes the popup, sets up references to the TinyMCE instance, configures styles and title, and attaches event handlers.

methods.name: onLoad
methods.description: Handles actions to be performed when the popup window loads, such as applying templates and adjusting form element directions.

methods.name: executeOnLoad
methods.description: Executes a string of JavaScript code when the popup is loaded, with special handling for Opera browser.

methods.name: resizeToInnerSize
methods.description: Resizes the popup window to match the content's inner size, with specific logic for different browsers.

methods.name: resizeToContent
methods.description: Resizes the window to fit its content dimensions, handling different browser behaviors.

methods.name: getWindowArg
methods.description: Retrieves arguments passed to the window via TinyMCE's window argument mechanism.

methods.name: restoreSelection
methods.description: Restores the previous text selection within the editor if stored.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes a command on the TinyMCE selected instance, restoring prior selection before execution.

methods.name: pickColor
methods.description: Invokes the color picker command in TinyMCE.

methods.name: openBrowser
methods.description: Opens the file browser dialog via a callback specified in TinyMCE parameters.

methods.name: importClass
methods.description: Imports a class from the opener window into the current window's scope.
